name: Floating Status Bars
summary: Health, stamina and anything else as bars in world space, riding above an actor's head.
description: The shared scripting contract has no viewport: a script cannot know how wide the window is, so it cannot pin anything to a screen corner. These bars sidestep that by living in the world and following an actor, which is correct at any resolution, on a phone as well as a desktop, and in a top-down game is where the player is already looking. Each bar is fed by naming a function on the target's own script, so no coupling beyond a name.
nextSteps: Put FloatingBars.js on an empty actor -- it builds its own sprites at start.
Set targetTag to the actor the bars follow, usually Player.
List the getter names in `sources`: each must exist on the target's script and return 0..1.
